\documentclass[tikz,border=4pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots, amssymb}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\usetikzlibrary{positioning, arrows.meta}
\definecolor{accent}{RGB}{200,60,40}
\tikzset{box/.style={draw, rounded corners=2pt, minimum width=1.6cm}}
\newcommand{\R}{\mathbb{R}}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[>=Stealth]
  % --- named points ---
  \coordinate (O) at (0,0);
  \coordinate (A) at (3,0);

  \draw[thick, accent] (O) -- (A); % the base
  \draw[dash pattern=on 3pt off 1pt] (0,1) -- (3,1);
  \node[box] (n1) at (0,2) {Input $\R$};
  \node[box, right=1cm of n1] (n2) {Output};
  \draw[->] (n1) -- (n2);
  \foreach \i in {0,...,3}
    \fill (\i,-1) circle (2pt);
  \begin{scope}[shift={(5,0)}, rotate=10]
    \draw (0,0) rectangle (1,1);   % inside a scope
    \node at (0.5,0.5) {s};
  \end{scope}
  \begin{axis}[at={(0,-6cm)}, width=5cm, height=4cm]
    \addplot[domain=0:2] {x^2};
  \end{axis}
  \draw (6,-1) -- (7,-1);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
